brand.policy: Preserve Vending Machines as pack family brand.

machine.meaning: Automated shop using villager profession trade tables; never an actual villager profession change.

upgrade.meaning: Upgrade Kit enables discounted trades. Villager tiers remain engine-managed.

regional.policy: Spain: valla/cantero; Mexico: cerca/albañil. Portugal: talhante and partilhado; Brazil: açougueiro and compartilhado.

vanilla_reference.status: Documented sample terminology, not checked in game. Installed extracted 1.26.52 .lang files are empty.

professions.meaning: Use vanilla Bedrock profession names in standalone labels after a colon where that avoids incorrect grammatical inflection.

style.audience: Minecraft players; concise UI and gentle woodland narrative where applicable.
style.address: Czech respectful plural address; Spanish tú; Portuguese Portugal tu, Brazil você; German du; French tu; Polish ty. Avoid assuming player gender.
style.review: AI draft, not independently language-reviewed or tested in game.
style.reference: Locale list verified in installed 1.26.52 reference. Vanilla terminology checked against Mojang bedrock-samples commit 46ba6ea985fb5a92d79a9419198f10dda14c199d; sample terms documented, not checked in game.
